subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: If a square has a side of 5 cm, what is its perimeter?
solution: Perimeter of a square = 4 * side = 4 * 5 = 20 cm. Topic (Mensuration) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
